app.tagline: Learn physics by building games with blocks
lang.label: Language
lesson.programHelp: Drag blocks under "when Run is pressed". Only blocks that are connected will run.
lesson.startOverConfirm: Do you want to erase your program and go back to the starting blocks?
lesson.noMoreHints: You have seen all the hints. You can do it!
lesson.ready: Build your program and press Run.
lesson.tryAgain: Almost. Change your program and try again.
blocks.whenRunTooltip: The blocks connected under this one run when you press Run.
blocks.setGravityTooltip: Choose the place in the universe where the game happens. Each place has a different gravity.
blocks.setMass: set the mass of %1 to %2 kg
blocks.setMassTooltip: Changes how much mass (matter) the object has, in kilograms.
blocks.dropTooltip: Lets go of the object. It keeps moving sideways while it falls.
errors.title: The lesson could not be opened
errors.noLesson: No lesson was chosen. Go back to the lesson list and pick one.
errors.notFound: We could not find the file {file}. Check that it is inside the lessons folder and that its name is spelled correctly in catalog.json.
errors.badJson: The file {file} has a typing mistake (for example, a missing comma or quote). Details: {detail}
errors.missingText: In {file}, the field "{field}" needs text in Spanish ("es") and English ("en").
errors.badValue: In {file}, the field "{field}" has a value ILO does not know: "{value}".
errors.badReference: In {file}, the field "{field}" mentions "{value}", but there is no object or zone with that id.
errors.checkHint: Tip: run "npm run check" to check all lessons.
world.help: Click to walk or use the arrow keys. Keys 1 to 8: emotes. 9: dance. 0: sit.
world.comingSoonText: This minigame is still being built. Come back soon!
errors.mapTitle: The map could not be opened
shop.title: Shop
house.help: Drag furniture into your house. Drag a piece down here to put it away.
house.empty: You have no furniture in the box. Buy some at the shop in the plaza.
shop.tab.head: Head
blocks.setSurfaceTooltip: Choose what the track where the sled brakes is made of. Each surface has a different friction (μ).
blocks.pushTooltip: Launches the object forward at its starting speed.
blocks.moveFulcrumTooltip: Moves the pivot point of the lever. The numbers are meters from the left.
lesson.predictHelp: It's optional. You can run without guessing.
lesson.zoneRange: The zone goes from {from} to {to} m.
save.unavailable: This browser can't save your progress (private mode or blocked storage). You can play, but it will be lost when you close it.
home.stateHelp: Explored: you tried it. Solved: you won the mission. Applied: you also solved the changed case.
save.export: Save a copy of my progress
save.importConfirm: Your progress on this computer will be replaced by the copy. Continue?
save.notIlo: That file is not an ILO copy. Look for the file that starts with ilo-avance.
save.tooNew: That copy is from a newer version of ILO. Ask your teacher to update ILO on this computer.
home.resetConfirm: Erase everything saved on this computer: coins, clothes, pets, house, stamps and lessons? This cannot be undone.
home.resetDone: Done. All progress on this computer was erased.
teacher.title: Teacher notes
teacher.prerequisites: What they need to know first
blocks.magnetPickTooltip: The crane lowers its magnet over the object. If the magnet pulls it, the crane carries it to the bin. Each time counts as one trip.
blocks.magnetPoleTooltip: Choose which pole of the crane's magnet faces down.
blocks.setRubSurfaceTooltip: Choose the surface the block is rubbed on.
blocks.rubTooltip: Rubs the block back and forth. Each rub warms it a little.
lesson.fairQuestion: Fair comparison: tick two runs that tell you what {variable} does.
lesson.fairRight: A fair comparison! Only one thing changes, so the difference in the result comes from it.
lesson.fairSameVariable: In those two runs {variable} is the same, so they can't tell you what it does. Pick two where it changes.
lesson.fairNotKept: In those two runs this also changes: {list}. Then you can't tell what caused the difference. Pick two where only one thing changes.
curriculum.direct: Grade {grade} · Directly supports Mexico's SEP program
curriculum.preparation: Grade {grade} · Prepares a topic in Mexico's SEP program
curriculum.extensionNoGrade: Extension: not in Mexico's SEP primary program
summary.title: Teacher summary
summary.help: What this computer saved for the student who used it. Erase progress between students from the lesson list.
summary.limits: Limits: only the last 10 runs of each lesson are kept. The columns are clues to observe and talk about, not a grade.
summary.manyOptions: Tried {n} options before winning: ask why it worked
path.predictSavedText: You chose: {guess}. Now build your program and run it to see what happens.
path.fairNeedRuns: To compare, you need two runs with a different {variable}. Go back to the experiment and try another one.
path.week: Lessons solved this week on this computer: {n}.
critterFacts.firefly: Their light gives off almost no heat: it is a cold light.
critterFacts.songbird: Many birds sing the most at dawn.
critterFacts.pigeon: Pigeons can find their way home from far away.
critterFacts.squirrel: They bury seeds and forget some, and new trees grow from them.
critterFacts.snow-hare: Its fur turns white in winter so it can hide in the snow.
critterFacts.meerkat: While the group eats, one meerkat stands on two legs and keeps watch.
critterFacts.seal: Seals breathe air: they come up to holes in the ice to breathe.
critterFacts.duck: Water slides off its feathers, which have a layer of oil.
critterFacts.jumping-fish: Some fish jump out of the water to escape or to catch insects.
critterFacts.elephant: They drink with their trunk: they fill it with water and empty it into their mouth.
critterFacts.bird-flock: Flying in a V shape helps birds use less energy.
critterFacts.crab: Crabs walk sideways because that is how their legs bend best.
critterFacts.toucan: Its beak is big but light, and it helps it lose heat.
critterFacts.macaw: Scarlet macaws live in the rainforests of southern Mexico and can live for many years.
critterFacts.heron: The heron waits very still in the water and catches fish very fast.
critterFacts.sea-turtle: Sea turtles return to the beach where they hatched to lay their eggs.
world.guideHelp: Walk near the animals in the world to add them here.
world.spotted: New in your field guide: {name}! +{n} coins
toyHelp.ball: Walk into it to kick it. It rolls farther on ice than on sand.
toyHelp.seesaw: Sit on one end and watch it go down.
toyHelp.swing: Get on. Press Use again to swing higher.
toyHelp.bounce-mushroom: Each bounce takes you a little higher.
toyHelp.sled-hill: Ride down on a sled: on snow it slides a long way.
toyHelp.water-wheel: Open the gate: the falling water turns the wheel.
toyHelp.marimba-stones: Step on the stones to play notes.
toyHelp.paper-boat: Put it on the water and watch it float.
toyHelp.magnet-rock: Walk up to the lost spoon and see what happens.
toyHelp.kite: Fly the kite. Press Use again to put it away.
world.liteOn: Light mode: fewer animations so it runs faster.
furnitureUse.toggle: Open it or switch it on.
furnitureUse.music: Play some music. Again to stop it.
world.partyWelcome: There is a {name} party in the plaza!
world.partyGift: Party gift: {name}. Wear it from the shop.
